trouble_ollama_shows: “Ollama isn’t running. Start it to search.” · “Embedder isn’t running. Search waits for it” · “Embedder is running without bge-m3”
trouble_ollama_fix: Ollama has to be running to search or index. Install it from ollama.com and open it; if it runs without its model, run {#code}ollama pull bge-m3{/code} once in a terminal. Help → Guides shows which part is missing.
trouble_index_fix: Hover that line in the status bar for each book's reason. {#em}Empty or scanned PDF{/em} means its pages are pictures with no text: run it through an OCR tool, then tick it again. A locked or damaged PDF fails the same way. If every book failed at once, Ollama is likely down (above).
trouble_weak: Search finds nothing, or only weak matches
trouble_weak_shows: “Everything is muted.” · “Nothing indexed is playing.” · “Nothing under the soloed items.” · “No strong matches — the content may be outside the current scope.”
trouble_weak_fix: A playing collection, a solo or a mute is narrowing the search. The {#strong}B{/strong} switch on the scope bar ({#strong}B{/strong} outside a text field) sets them all aside until you throw it back. Faded rows are weak matches; {#em}Settings → General → Dim weak matches{/em} turns the fading off.
trouble_mcp: The AI agent can't reach the library
trouble_mcp_shows: “MCP not detected” on the status bar lamp · the agent says “Cannot connect to Unseen Servant”
trouble_mcp_fix: Unseen Servant has to be running: closing its window doesn't quit it, quitting does. Check the config is in the agent's MCP settings (Help → Guides → Servant) and restart the agent after any edit. If the app moved since you copied the config, copy it again: the config holds the app's location.
trouble_offline_shows: “Sidecar didn’t start. Search and indexing are offline” · “Library store didn’t open” · “Indexer failed to start. See log: …”
trouble_offline_fix: Quit Unseen Servant and open it again; a first launch after installing can be slow. If it fails again, copy {#em}sidecar.log{/em} out of the data folder before reopening, as every launch starts a new one, and send it with your report (below).
trouble_library: The library folder can't be reached
trouble_library_shows: “Library folder isn’t reachable: …” · “Library folder is no longer accessible: …” · “Library folder isn’t responding: …”
trouble_library_fix: Connect the drive or network share it lives on. If the folder moved, choose it again in {#em}Settings → Library{/em}. On macOS, also check that {#em}System Settings → Privacy & Security → Files and Folders{/em} lets Unseen Servant in.
trouble_campaigns_fix: Connect the drive it lives on, or pick the folder again in {#em}Settings → Command{/em} (on macOS, also {#em}File → Change Campaigns Folder…{/em}).
trouble_stuck_fix: Write with what you see, and {#em}sidecar.log{/em} if search or indexing is involved.
reference_shortcuts: Press {#kbd}?{/kbd} outside a text field, or click the keyboard key in the status bar, to see every shortcut.

glossary_arm_desc: While a collection or a beat is armed (●), clicks file things in or out
glossary_solo_desc: Narrow search to a book, folder or game system (S)
glossary_mute_desc: Leave a book, folder, game system or collection out of search (M)
glossary_bypass_desc: Set every play, solo and mute aside without clearing them (B)
glossary_strength_desc: How closely a result matches; weak ones fade
glossary_campaign_desc: A folder in the campaigns folder, holding all it uses
glossary_track_desc: A folder in a campaign, shown as a column: NPCs, Secrets…
glossary_note_desc: A Markdown file; [[Name]] links to one
glossary_shelf_desc: Notes gathered but not filed on a track yet
glossary_beat_desc: A scene: the notes it needs
glossary_session_desc: The beats planned for one game
glossary_prep_play_desc: Arranging and running, switched with Tab
glossary_launch_desc: Put a beat or a note in play (P)
glossary_live_set_desc: The notes in play right now
glossary_spent_desc: Used up at the table, and dimmed from then on (A)
glossary_board_desc: Play's cards, one board per session
glossary_card_tray_desc: The live set as a hand of cards, under the board
glossary_sidecar_desc: Indexes and searches in the background; the status bar's first lamp
glossary_embedder_desc: Ollama with bge-m3, reading text for meaning; the second lamp
glossary_mcp_desc: How an AI agent reaches the library and campaigns; the third lamp
glossary_rack_desc: The main window's tools, laid out in views; 1–8 switch views
reference_keywords_desc: A book gets a game system when one of that system's keywords appears in its path (folders and filename) or, failing that, near the start of its text. Case, spaces, accents and punctuation don't count, and {#em}&{/em} reads as {#em}n{/em}: {#em}d&d 5e{/em}, {#em}dnd-5e{/em} and {#em}DnD 5E{/em} all match. Keep keywords to four characters or more; shorter ones turn up inside unrelated words.
reference_keywords_search: Name a system in a search and its books come first.
reference_mcp_desc: What an AI agent connected through MCP can do. Command tools work on the campaign open in the app unless the agent names another.
mcp_search_library: Search by meaning, optionally within a source, game system or collection
mcp_get_section: Read a whole section from a search result
mcp_get_pages: Read up to 20 pages of a PDF as text
mcp_list_game_systems: List the game systems in the library
mcp_campaign_overview: The campaigns, then the open one's tracks, notes, beats and sessions

mcp_live_set: The notes in play, in full

mcp_find_notes: Find notes by name or text

mcp_edit_note: Replace a note's text, keeping its frontmatter
mcp_create_track: Make a new track at the end of the tracks
mcp_move_note: Move a note to another track or the shelf
mcp_create_beat: Make a beat from notes, with its scene, optionally in a session
